atoms.text: Um Aufforderungen in indirekter Rede wiederzugeben, wird das Verb im Infinitiv verwendet. Man kann sie mit to tell, to ask, to advise, to remind oder to warn einleiten.

instruction.text: In welcher Form muss das Verb eingesetzt werden? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: “You should wear your new jumper tonight.”
atoms.b: Joaquin told his mother ((++to_wear wear wearing)) her new jumper that night.

atoms.a: “Next time, you should bring an umbrella.”

atoms.a: “You’ll make breakfast, and I’ll clean the dishes.”

instruction.text: Gib die Aufforderung indirekt wieder, indem du den Satz bildest. Beginne mit dem Begleitsatz.

atoms.a: Joane said, “Please, help me with the dishes.”
Zuri said, “Ask again if you haven't understood it.”
Wendall said, “Enjoy your trip to Portugal.”
Chris said, “Don't watch this show. It's terrible.”
